sessions.title: Registration
Kick Off / Welcome Session
Biz Apps & Microsoft 365: Better Together, Customizing Copilot Agents with Copilot Studio & Azure AI
sessions.description:
Copilot-Powered Transformation: Unifying Microsoft 365 & Biz Apps with Copilot Studio + Azure AI Foundry

AI is no longer a future vision—it’s transforming how we work today. Join us for a dynamic session exploring how the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem is reshaping business operations by unifying Microsoft 365 and Business Applications (Biz Apps) through Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry.
We’ll demonstrate how organizations can customize Copilot Agents to create intelligent, domain-specific solutions across the full enterprise stack—from productivity tools like Outlook and 
Overview:
This session dives deep into how organizations can accelerate digital transformation by integrating Microsoft 365 Copilot with Business Applications (Biz Apps) — such as Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform — to deliver tailored, intelligent experiences using Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry.
With Copilot now available across both productivity and business platforms, businesses have a unique opportunity to go beyond out-of-the-box capabilities. The session will showcase how to design, build, and operationalize custom Copilot Agents that adapt to specific industry needs, customer journeys, and operational workflows.

💡 What You’ll Learn
🔷 1. The Strategic Value of a Unified Copilot Ecosystem
	• How Microsoft 365 Copilot and Dynamics 365 Copilot work better together
	• Benefits of aligning front-office (Outlook, Teams, Word) with back-office (Sales, Service, Finance) automation
	• Use cases across Sales, Customer Service, and Finance that drive measurable business outcomes
🔷 2. End-to-End Data & Process Integration
	• How to establish a seamless flow of data across Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, and Power Platform
	• Leveraging unified identity, data connectors, and contextual AI via Dataverse and Azure OpenAI
	• Real-world example: Connecting CRM opportunities in Dynamics 365 with meeting summaries in Outlook and predictive insights in Excel
🔷 3. Copilot Studio: Customizing with No-Code/Pro-Code Agility
	• Live walkthrough of customizing a Copilot Agent for a specific business workflow (e.g., onboarding a new client or automating approvals)
	• Use of triggers, generative AI skills, plugins, and orchestration actions
	• Best practices for governance, security, and user adoption
🔷 4. Azure AI Foundry: Deep AI Customization at Scale
	• How to fine-tune foundation models with your enterprise data
	• Deploying AI responsibly with enterprise-grade safeguards
	• Industry examples: Health chatbot for patients, predictive forecasting for finance, AI concierge for customer service
🔷 5. New Innovations

sessions.title: Securing Modern Work: Automating Intune to Unlock Productivity Without Compromise
sessions.description: In a world of remote work, AI, and constant change, how can IT teams stay ahead without falling behind on security or productivity? This session explores how automation can transform Microsoft Intune from a complex overhead into a scalable advantage. We'll share real-world strategies to standardize security, reduce manual work, and prepare for AI features like Microsoft Copilot — all while maintaining a seamless user experience. Perfect for IT leaders, architects, and admins looking to do more with less.

sessions.title: Building a Copilot-First Solution with Copilot Studio and AI Builder
sessions.description:
AI-powered copilots are transforming the way we build solutions, but how do you create one from scratch? In this live build session, we'll walk through the process of designing a Copilot-first solution using Copilot Studio and AI Builder.

You'll learn:
✅ How to structure a Copilot-first approach for real-world applications
✅ How to integrate AI Builder to enhance Copilot’s capabilities
✅ Best practices for optimizing prompts and AI interactions

Whether you're new to Copilot Studio or looking to level up your AI-powered solutions, this session will give you practical, hands-on experience and insights into the power of low-code AI.

sessions.title: Pilot to Copilot: You are not clear for takeoff!
sessions.description: You don't let M365 Copilot fly without doing your due diligence. Data readiness is key, and we'll discuss some of the tools you can include in your plan to rollout and manage M365 Copilot deployment, including Restricted Search, SharePoint Advanced Management, Purview and even M365 Copilot Chat. And no, Copilot doesn't use your data to train AI.

sessions.title: Transforming Employee Engagement with AI-Driven Intranets
sessions.description:
Discover how Copilot can revolutionize your intranet by creating highly personalized and engaging experiences. 

This session covers practical strategies for leveraging Microsoft Viva, Copilot, automated content curation, and intelligent search capabilities. Learn to anticipate employee needs, deliver relevant content effortlessly, and significantly enhance overall employee interaction and satisfaction with your intranet.

sessions.title: Turn Up the Volume: How Viva Amplify Elevates Your Communications
sessions.description:
Do your internal campaigns fall flat or get lost in the noise? Viva Amplify is here to help you elevate your messaging across Microsoft 365—at scale and with precision. This session will show you how to streamline communication planning, publish content across channels like SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, and Viva Engage, and measure its impact. Whether you're in corporate communications, HR, or change management, you'll leave with practical strategies to engage your audience more effectively using Viva Amplify. 

By the end of the session, attendees will be able to: 
 - Understand the role of Viva Amplify  
 - Create a communication campaign  
 - Write, schedule, and publish content  
 - Target specific audiences  
 - Measure engagement and effectiveness  
 - Collaborate with stakeholders  

Don’t let your message get lost in the noise. Learn how to deliver targeted, multi-channel campaigns with Viva Amplify—and measure the impact.

sessions.title: Empowering Internal Customer Service Roles with Copilot Agents
sessions.description:
Internal customer service roles often face the challenge of managing repetitive and interrupt-driven tasks. Microsoft 365’s custom Copilots provide a powerful solution by automating routine processes, allowing professionals to focus more on strategic initiatives and more meaningful work.

Join us as we explore how to develop and implement Copilot Agents tailored to support internal customer service roles. We will cover use cases in Human Resources where Copilot can streamline tasks like onboarding, supporting hiring, and addressing benefits questions. Discover how these intelligent assistants can efficiently handle routine inquiries, reducing interruptions and free up valuable time to build deeper connections across the organization. Empower your team with the tools to transform their workflow and enhance their impact.

sessions.title: Empowering corporate communications with Microsoft 365
sessions.description: Creating and delivering compelling and consistent corporate communications messages across multiple channels can be challenging, especially in the fast-paced and dynamic business environment. In this session, you will learn tips and best practices to improve internal communications. We will talk about new and emerging capabilities in SharePoint News and Viva Engage along with premium capabilities available with Viva Amplify and Copilot. Whether you’re a seasoned communicator or a curious novice, this session promises actionable insights, practical tips, and a dash of innovation.

sessions.title: Using GenAI and Copilots with a Targeted Data Set
sessions.description: This session will showcase Crow Canyon's NITRO Copilot. Built using Microsoft Azure and Crow Canyon's technologies, NITRO Copilot uses a targeted data set that allows precise control over the enterprise data used by AI. This allows the Copilot to present safe, timely, and accurate responses while avoiding the pitfalls and costs of Microsoft 365 Copilot and MS Graph. It also solves the data governance issue where the broad reach of MS Graph can unearth outdated, inaccurate, and biased data.

sessions.title: Building Your First CRUD App using Dataverse for Teams with Copilot
sessions.description:
We'll learn how to leverage Copilot and AI to quickly turn an Excel table into a Dataverse schema, with data and a fully functional low-code app using the assistance of AI and Copilot Studio.

Microsoft Dataverse for Teams delivers a no code / low code out of the box data platform for Microsoft Teams. You get relational data storage, rich data types, enterprise-grade governance, and one-click solution deployment. Dataverse for Teams enables everyone to easily build and deploy apps. Come see what Dataverse for Teams is all about and how to get started building databased apps within Teams.

sessions.title: Maximize your SharePoint content with no-code custom Copilots
sessions.description:
Looking for a little more out of Microsoft 365 Copilot when it comes to knowledge and search? After rolling it out, did you immediately ask yourself, "Yeah, but how do I scope this to specific information so I don't get bad or extraneous responses?" Yep, that's the first thing everyone says after seeing the impact of M365 Copilot. Pretty good, but... kind of risky being scoped to literally every file, chat, and email in your tenant.

Join Matt for a session that covers how SharePoint gives you an easy, high-value way to create custom Q&A Copilots without writing a single line of code. Imagine having a team of Q&A bots that are laser-focused on specific knowledge sources, providing vetted support and answers without getting lost in the vast expanse of—let's face it—the mess that is the corpus of files in your M365 tenant. All built into the M365 Copilot experience or direct chats in Microsoft Teams.

This session isn't just about theory; it's a practical guide tailored to admins and content owners who are serious about taking advantage of and providing a robust AI-as-a-service model. Don't miss out on this opportunity to be part of the AI evolution and revolution in an easy, democratic way.

sessions.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot. Copilot Agents and What is to Come!
sessions.description: A walk through of the past 2 years and the capabilities that Microsoft has been adding to Microsoft 365 from Copilot to Copilot agents and the capabilities to manage and protect your data as more advancements in AI continue

sessions.title: Secure Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, and Entra ID Data Against Cyber Threats
sessions.description: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Dynamics 365 form the backbone of many business operations, seamlessly integrating to drive efficiency and innovation. However, this interconnected power also expands the attack surface, increasing the potential risk of data loss and security breaches. Protecting your critical data across these platforms is no longer optional—it’s essential to ensuring business continuity and swift recovery from cyber incidents. In this session, we’ll uncover the key vulnerabilities, and provide actionable strategies to strengthen your data security posture against evolving threats

sessions.title: Securing AI Interactions: Building Data Security in Copilot Studio Agents
sessions.description:
This hands-on session is for IT professionals, developers, and business leaders committed to safeguarding sensitive data while utilizing AI-powered solutions in Copilot Studio. Participants will gain practical knowledge in implementing robust data security, including encryption, data redaction, and role-based access control. Through guided demos and real-world applications, attendees will learn to secure their AI agents across multiple communication channels, such as Teams, Email, and Web Portals, to meet organizational needs.

The session emphasizes relevant and practical skill-building, encouraging participants to directly apply what they learn to their real-world challenges. Attendees will leave with actionable insights and the confidence to deploy secure, scalable solutions.

Real-World Scenarios Demonstrated:
Scenario 1: Data Redaction for Customer Support Queries
Scenario 2: Role-Based Access for Sensitive Data Retrieval

sessions.title: Using Copilot with Microsoft Office Apps
sessions.description: Deb will present top tips for using Copilot with M365 Apps: Word, Excel, Power Point, Business Chat, One Note, Teams and Whiteboard. We will review prompts that work and best practices.

sessions.title: From Tech Expert to Strategic Leader: Rethink How You Lead
sessions.description:
Most IT professionals are great at solving problems and rolling out new features. But being a strategic leader means thinking beyond quick fixes and running systems smoothly. It’s about building solutions that make sense for the long haul.
The real challenge is shifting your mindset from managing tasks to driving strategy. It means asking more thoughtful questions, making intentional choices, and guiding your team to think beyond the daily grind.

This session will explain how to move from a tech expert to a strategic leader. You’ll learn how to build a culture that encourages curiosity and critical thinking and how to make decisions that connect today’s work to long-term goals.
Takeaways:

sessions.title: Beyond Automation: Measuring AI Proficiency to Unlock True Business Value
sessions.description:
AI adoption is accelerating across industries, but implementation alone doesn’t guarantee success. Organizations often focus on surface-level engagement metrics—system logins, automation rates, and AI-driven outputs—without assessing whether employees truly understand and leverage AI capabilities. 

The result? Billions lost in unrealized ROI as AI tools remain underutilized or misapplied.

This session redefines AI adoption by introducing a proficiency-first framework that ensures organizations extract real value from their AI investments. 

Attendees will gain insights into:
•	The hidden gap between AI implementation and actual workforce adoption
•	Why traditional tech adoption metrics fail to capture AI utilization
•	Practical strategies for measuring AI proficiency beyond engagement statistics
•	The impact of AI-driven decisions on operational efficiency, revenue, and customer experience

sessions.title: How the M365 community saved my life: finding purpose, belonging, and strength in tech
sessions.description: This isn’t your typical tech talk. In this unfiltered session, Diego opens up about how our M365 community became his lifeline during one of the darkest chapters of his life. Through connection, purpose, and countless moments of shared humanity, he found not just healing—but his true voice. That voice eventually led him to the stage as a community speaker. This is a story about resilience, authenticity, and the power of never giving up. Whether you’re recovering from burnout, searching for belonging, or learning to turn pain into purpose, this session will remind you that showing up as your full self is your greatest strength—and that the best community in tech might just be the key to unlocking it.

sessions.title: From CoPilot to Agentic AI: Unlocking Enterprise-Grade Autonomy in the Microsoft 365 Ecosystem
sessions.description:
Ties directly to M365’s evolution (CoPilot, Loop, Graph API, Azure OpenAI integrations).
Positions you as a forward-thinking leader on autonomous systems, not just AI add-ons.
Resonates with CIOs, developers, and solution architects trying to move from GenAI trials to real-world impact.

sessions.title: Exploring Microsoft 365 Copilot’s Out-of-the-box Agents
sessions.description: In today's dynamic work environment, building an agentic workplace is crucial for driving productivity and innovation. In this session we will explore the capabilities of Microsoft 365 Copilot's out-of-the-box agents and how they can transform how you work.

sessions.title: Let's Talk M365 Copilot Adoption, a Cosmic Copilot Adventure
sessions.description:
Ready for liftoff? Join us on a six-week space odyssey that transformed our internal Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment into a model for customer-facing success. In this practical session, we'll share how our "Cosmic Copilot Adventure" program achieved an extraordinary 97% adoption rate through a change strategy grounded in human-centered design, gamification, and measurable business outcomes.

From 'Launch Day' preparations to 'Discovering Alien Productivity,' you'll learn how we orchestrated everything from initial user agreements to daily education missions. Fueled by strong executive sponsorship and a dedicated Change Agent Team, our journey included:

Launch Day readiness: Getting users aligned and excited from Day 1

Prompt-a-thons and the CLEAR framework: Building prompt literacy through structured creativity challenges

Design Thinking workshops: Mapping use cases to job functions and real workflows

Community building: How we created tight-knit cohorts in Teams that graduated into a thriving company-wide Copilot community of practice

Continuous measurement: How our business value framework tracked ROI with a value realization model that leadership embraced

We'll explore how our space exploration-themed approach turned adoption friction into fuel, creating sustained momentum and genuine culture change. Our Teams-based community strategy fostered peer learning, where cohort members shared discoveries, celebrated wins, and collaboratively solved challenges before joining the larger organizational community as Copilot champions.

Join us for this mission briefing and leave with a constellation of actionable strategies, templates, and lessons learned that you can immediately apply to your own M365 Copilot journey – whether you're planning for liftoff or looking to reach new heights with your existing program.

sessions.title: Automating Azure Virtual Desktop Deployment with VS Code and GitHub Copilot
sessions.description: Join Microsoft MVP and Product Technology Architect, Kristopher Turner, for a live demo on automating Azure Virtual Desktop deployments to Azure and Azure Local using GitHub Copilot and  VS Code. Learn how to accelerate hybrid AVD rollouts, apply governance with Azure Policy, and streamline operations with AI-assisted Infrastructure as Code. Whether you're managing Microsoft 365 environments, enabling remote work, or securing hybrid edge deployments, this session is packed with actionable insights

sessions.title: How to build a Gen AI Chatbot in 3 steps
sessions.description:
Are you looking to see how Generative AI can help your company? This session will provide an in-depth look into key learnings from a real-life pioneering journey of developing a generative AI chatbot for employees, powered by Microsoft's cutting-edge technologies. We will explore the challenges encountered, the strategic decisions made, and the creative solutions devised during this transformative 3 step process.  

The discussion will underscore how to harness power of Microsoft's AI and cloud technologies to create a chatbot that improved communication, streamlined workflows, and enhanced employee productivity. Attendees will gain a comprehensive understanding of a journey, from the initial conceptualization to the final deployment and ongoing improvements. This session will serve as a resource for organizations planning to leverage AI chatbots, offering insights, best practices, and lessons learned.

sessions.title: Real World Microsoft 365 Governance in the Age of AI
sessions.description:
In a time where everyone is expected to innovate faster, deliver more value, and do it all under tight budget constraints, effective governance is more critical than ever. Microsoft is at the forefront of driving this innovation with their Copilot “GenAI-as-a-Service” offering and creating custom agents with Copilot Studio & Azure AI Foundry. However, these benefits are not without their challenges, including:

• Ensuring AI doesn’t expose sensitive data to those who should not have access to it
• Improving data quality to ensure AI returns accurate answers
• Balancing operational costs while embracing innovation

Join us for a deep dive into best practices for governing Microsoft 365 in this new world of AI & Copilots. We’ll explore some of the tools that Microsoft makes available while also pointing out some gaps. Whether you’re facing complex compliance requirements, struggling with data sprawl, or simply looking for ways to do more with less, this session will provide the real-world strategies needed to thrive in today’s AI-driven landscape.

sessions.title: Lunch
Security Copilot Agents: building the future of agentic AI for security
sessions.description: Security copilot now has an agent platform that allows users to build their own agents based on the security copilot LLM. Watch them in action and learn how to build your own.

sessions.title: What's new and exciting in Microsoft 365 Copilot for FY26
sessions.description:
This session will explore the latest innovations in Microsoft 365 Copilot as we begin Microsoft's FY26, showcasing how AI is transforming productivity, personalization, and collaboration across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Attendees will get a first look at new capabilities, user experiences, and admin controls designed to help organizations unlock the full potential of Copilot.

What Attendees Will Learn:
Enhanced User Experience: Discover the redesigned Microsoft 365 Copilot app with a streamlined interface, new modules like Notebooks and Agent Store, and deeper personalization features.
Copilot for Everyone: Learn how both licensed and unlicensed users benefit from updates, including simplified chat, prompt suggestions, and mobile-first enhancements.
AI Agents in Action: Get introduced to the new Researcher and Analyst agents—part of the Frontier program—designed to tackle complex research and data analysis tasks with human-like reasoning.
Copilot Extensibility: See how new Microsoft Graph connectors expand Copilot’s reach into platforms like Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk, and more.
Admin & Compliance Enhancements: Understand the new controls for managing Copilot behavior, agent permissions, and data processing—including the Enhanced Personalization setting and expanded AI Admin roles.
Copilot in the Flow of Work: Explore how Copilot is now integrated across Teams, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and OneDrive—including features like audio overviews, translated recaps, and form generation.

sessions.title: When to use which AI tool in the Microsoft Cloud
sessions.description: Microsoft has created many AI tools across Azure and Microsoft 365. With so many choices how do you know which tool is the best choice for your needs? Cost, existing usage, approval, complexity, and security & compliance capabilities all come into play to make an informed decision. In this session we will compare custom Copilots, Agent Builder, SharePoint AI, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and Azure AI Foundry to understand the differences of each and when you should choose which one for your project.

sessions.title: From Code to Intelligence – Building NextGen AI Agents
sessions.description:
You've built functions and optimized workflows—but are your AI agents actually intelligent? 

Building on my 2024 M365 Community Days NYC session, "Introduction to Semantic Kernel," we now explore agentic Coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, VS Code, Cursor, and others) to understand how programming is evolving from a purely functional task into a more creative and expressive craft requiring fresh thinkers with engineer mindsets.

In this session, you'll learn:
• Understand Agentic AI Break down the architecture behind intelligent, adaptive AI agents.
• Understand Agentic Coding (Github Copilot, VS Code, Cursor, and others. See how the art of programming rises over the function of programming.
• Orchestrate AI with Semantic-Aware Functions – Use dynamic, context-driven functions to optimize agent orchestration and workflows.
• Manage Semantic App State – Enable AI systems to retain memory, adapt to interactions, and evolve in real-time.
• Apply Microsoft Research Insights – Leverage breakthroughs from AutoGen and Magentic-One to build enterprise-grade AI agents.

Whether you're looking to enhance your current AI applications or build something entirely new, this developer-focused session provides a roadmap to innovate confidently.

sessions.title: Next-Gen SharePoint: Elevating Collaboration with Copilot & Premium Integration
sessions.description:
In the rapidly evolving digital landscape, SharePoint continues to stand at the forefront of collaborative innovation. The introduction of Copilot in SharePoint marks a new chapter in its journey, offering unparalleled advancements in AI-driven collaboration and productivity. SharePoint Premium on the other hand helps you automate extracting data from your content to enhance your organization’s road to better compliance.
In this session, we will dive on how you can use AI in SharePoint to create Copilot custom models to generate files, and leverage SharePoint Premium to automate the content processing and extraction of your data.
You will learn how you can create an end-to-end solution for your users to enhance their collaboration using custom Copilot models in SharePoint, and to eliminate the manual document processing.

sessions.title: Absolute Beginner’s Guide to Power Automate
sessions.description:
If you want to start creating Power Automate Cloud Flows and have little to no experience, this session is for you! 

Here's what you'll learn:
 - What are Power Automate Cloud Flows and why you should care
 - Types of Cloud Flows
 - How to create Flows from a template and from scratch
 - How to debug your Flows
 - Power Automate and SharePoint, Excel and other data sources
 - Power Automate Expressions
 - Power Automate approvals
And more…

All concepts will be presented using live demos.
Copilot integration will he highlighted.
While this is not a hands-on session, attendees are welcome to follow along.

Attend this session and gain the skills that you need to star creating Power Automate Cloud Flows today!

sessions.title: Fast Tracking Data Governance for Copilot Using Copilot
sessions.description: Are you stuck in your M365 Copilot journey because of oversharing concerns and data governance issues? You're not alone. Fortunately, it turns out that Copilot itself can come to the rescue. This session shows how we've leveraged Copilot to rapidly gain visibility into what is overshared, jumpstart our ability to use SharePoint Advancement Management and Purview, and ultimately accelerate our data governance journey so that we can deploy Copilot with confidence.

sessions.title: Dataverse: Everything, Everywhere, Here and There
sessions.description: Are you building Power Platform solutions, and still storing your data in SQL Server, SharePoint Online, and/ or Excel? If so, then you may need to reevaluate and consider Microsoft Dataverse, the native data solution of the Power Platform. For many of your low-code initiatives, Dataverse is likely a better data storage offering. Designed to be a secure, low-code solution, Microsoft built Dataverse to help organizations increase their return on investment (ROI), better scale their in-house applications, and promote rapid innovation, even leveraging Microsoft Copilot. Let’s deep dive into Microsoft Dataverse and explore jumpstarting your team's productivity.

sessions.title: Choosing the Right Storage Solution for Modern Cloud Applications
sessions.description:
This session is designed for business users, developers, and administrators, including PowerApps, SharePoint and azure developers. 

It will explore how to select the best storage solution for your development project, whether developing in-house applications or purchasing from ISVs or Microsoft.

A comprehensive checklist will be provided to consider before starting your project, ensuring the most suitable storage option is chosen for your needs. The solutions covered will include SharePoint Embedded and SharePoint Document Library. Each solution will be compared based on different requirements, with a deep dive into the details of working with SharePoint Embedded.

The importance of data for your company and projects will be emphasized, highlighting how crucial it is for informed decision-making, problem-solving, and improving processes. Security and compliance aspects of each storage solution will also be covered, ensuring that your data is protected and meets regulatory requirements.

Additionally, the cost implications of each storage solution will be discussed, helping you make budget-conscious decisions. The session will also explore how AI and Copilot agents can enhance your storage strategy, from automating data management to improving data analytics.

By the end of this session, a clear understanding of the optimal storage solution for your needs will be achieved.

sessions.title: Mastering the BI Mullet – Managed Self Service BI
sessions.description:
Described by Microsoft as “discipline at the core and flexibility at the edge,” a Managed Self Service BI approach empowers end users by putting them in the report-writing driver’s seat while keeping any ETL (Extract, Transform, and Load) processes and semantic model design centrally maintained. This approach can be an ideal way to encourage innovative thinking and data analysis from across the organization. For organizations with limited IT staff availability and big business intelligence ambitions, a Managed Self Service BI strategy can also effectively spread the workload in a way that cuts down on the “game of telephone” that often results from time-consuming report requirements gathering efforts. By moving the reporting workload to those who best understand the report need, companies can make the most of the hours and expertise that are already available in house.

These potential benefits can only be achieved with careful implementation of systems that support both decentralized report writers and centralized data system managers, however. Any organization that wants to implement this strategy should think carefully about how to ensure consistency when it counts, lower the barriers to report writing, provide appropriate and create effective feedback loops that support report writers and central semantic model writers alike. 

This session will help you assess whether a “BI Mullet” approach is a fit for your organization based on its existing data culture, skills, and capacity. We’ll also cover how to minimize the strain on first-time report writers through pre-designed templates and collaborative trainings. Finally, well review how related tools such as Power Automate and Microsoft Forms can capture data-related improvement ideas through actionable feedback loops, helping to ensure that your organization’s data systems keep up with the latest insights and innovations from across your company.

sessions.title: Transcription Magic: Simplify Your Workflow with Azure and Power Platform
sessions.description:
Imagine effortlessly uploading your audio files, having them automatically transcribed, and having the power to edit and perfect those transcriptions — all inside a single Power App!

My demo showcases a user-friendly canvas app that makes transcription a breeze. Simply upload your audio, and let the magic happen. With the help of Azure's cutting-edge Speech-to-Text, your audio is stored securely and transcribed accurately in Dataverse. But that's not all! You can review and edit the transcriptions to ensure they are accurate.

The demo also includes fantastic features like:

* Automatic Summaries: Get concise summaries of your transcriptions generated by AI Builder (and Azure Open AI under the hood).
* Downloadable PDFs: Easily download your transcriptions as PDF files for convenient sharing and storage.
* Direct Uploads: Upload your audio files directly to Azure Blob Storage without any hassle.

And the best part?  The solution is open source and available for free, so you can use it today! So come see how I built it, then go home and try it yourself.

sessions.title: Revolutionizing SharePoint Workflows with Power Automate and Copilot
sessions.description:
In today’s fast-paced digital workplace, efficiency and automation are key to staying ahead. Join us for an exciting session where we delve into the transformative power of integrating Microsoft Copilot with SharePoint and Power Automate. Discover how Copilot’s AI capabilities can revolutionize your workflows, turning complex processes into seamless, automated tasks.

We’ll explore real-world scenarios where Copilot enhances SharePoint workflows, from automating routine approvals to managing intricate data processes. Learn how to harness the full potential of Power Automate to create intelligent, responsive workflows that adapt to your organization’s needs.

This session will feature live demonstrations, showcasing step-by-step how to build and deploy these advanced workflows. You’ll walk away with practical knowledge, best practices, and innovative ideas to implement in your own environment. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, this session will provide valuable insights to elevate your SharePoint and Power Automate skills to the next level.

Key Takeaways:

Understand the integration of Copilot with SharePoint and Power Automate.
Learn to create intelligent workflows that enhance efficiency and reduce manual tasks.
Gain insights from real-world examples and live demonstrations.
Discover best practices for implementing advanced automation in your organization.

Join us to unlock the future of workflow automation and see how Copilot can be your co-pilot in driving productivity and innovation!

sessions.title: Exploring Microsoft 365 Migration Options and Tools
sessions.description:
Congratulations, on your decision to move to Microsoft 365. If your mind is running rampant on how to complete the migration, this session is for you. We will begin by exploring the steps necessary during the following migration phases

        Planning the migration (process and tools)
        Completing the migration
        Managing the cloud-based content after migration

As you can guess, you’re going to need to know what the best approach is to complete the migration, so we will also discuss what your migration options are, and what tools are available, including how to use the SharePoint Migration Assessment Tool (SMAT) with the SharePoint Migration Tool (SPMT) to help streamline and successfully complete your migration to Microsoft 365.

sessions.title: Project Management in Microsoft 365
sessions.description: Tools like Planner, Planner Premium (aka Project for the Web), Project Online, and Task Lists make it confusing to understand which tool to use to manage different kinds of projects. Add Copilot's new Project Manager agent into the mix and it isn't always straightforward. Let's take a tour of these tools and leave the session knowing what to use for tracking tasks, running projects, and what can be automated or streamlined with a Copilot license.

sessions.title: Beyond Chatbots: Create Autonomous AI Agents Using Microsoft Copilot Studio
sessions.description:
AI is evolving — and it’s time to think beyond simple chatbots.

In this session, learn how to design Autonomous AI Agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio that not only respond to user queries, but also proactively complete tasks, orchestrate workflows, and act with context and purpose.

We’ll explore how Copilot Studio now supports multi-step reasoning, adaptive planning, and integrations across Microsoft 365 and external APIs — unlocking a new generation of agents that go beyond conversations to drive real action.

Topics we’ll cover:

What makes an AI Agent autonomous (vs a traditional chatbot)

Building multi-step reasoning and action planning into your Copilot workflows

Integrating Copilot Agents with Power Platform, Dataverse, and external systems

Real-world examples of Autonomous Agents in enterprises and government

Whether you're looking to automate internal processes, client services, or complex decision-making, this session will help you move from reactive chatbots to proactive AI agents.

sessions.title: No Degree Necessary - Building AI-Infused Low-code Power Apps
sessions.description:
Infusing Low-Code Apps with Powerful AI Models

In the age of AI, it’s no longer enough to build apps that respond—they must think. In this session, I’ll showcase how I built a resume screening solution using Power Apps and AI Builder, demonstrating how any maker can turn traditional forms and processes into intelligent, responsive experiences.

You’ll learn how to:
	•	Use AI Builder’s form processing to extract data from resumes (PDF/Word)
	•	Create AI prompts that analyze and rank candidates based on job criteria
	•	Build a sleek Power App UI for managing applicant workflows
	•	Leverage Power Automate for scoring & notifications
	•	Add a Copilot Studio chatbot to answer recruiter questions about applicants in natural language

Whether you’re in HR tech, operations, or just exploring how AI can elevate your apps, this session will leave you with a blueprint—and inspiration—for bringing intelligence to your low-code solutions.

Her recent work spans Copilot for Sales, Service, and Finance, enabling organizations to harness real-time insights, intelligent automation, and industry-specific AI solutions. Sonal brings deep experience in enterprise architecture, AI governance, cybersecurity, and partner enablement—having influenced co-sell and GTM strategies across hundreds of global partners and ISVs.

Prior to IBM, Sonal served as a Principal Architect at Microsoft’s Global Partner Solutions team, where she pioneered industry-led AI engagements and played a pivotal role in Microsoft’s Business Applications growth across the Americas. She also held solution leadership roles at GAF Corporation, Deloitte Consulting, Nortel, and government agencies in Australia.

Sonal holds multiple advanced degrees in Engineering and Business, is a certified PMP, and a Microsoft Certified Azure AI Engineer and Power Platform Architect. She is also a frequent speaker, panelist, and AI ethics advocate, passionately championing responsible AI and diversity in tech.
